name: Agency OS 01 · Agency Brain (Claude + skill playbooks)

parameters.content:
## Agency Brain
Every AI step in Agency OS calls this sub-workflow.

**Input item** must contain a `brain` object:
```
brain: {
  skill,        // marketingskills skill name, e.g. "seo-audit"
  task,         // what to produce
  context,      // string or object with the facts
  schema,       // optional JSON schema -> strict JSON output
  effort,       // low | medium | high | xhigh
  caller, client, max_tokens
}
```
**Returns** the same item (minus `brain`) plus `ai` (parsed JSON or text), `ai_text`, `ai_error`, `ai_meta` (tokens, cost).

The skill's `SKILL.md` is fetched from GitHub and becomes the system prompt, so the Brain always runs the latest playbook. Every call is logged to the **AI Ledger** tab for per-client AI cost tracking.
